'''Magical Pokémon Journey: Green Jealousy''' is the twenty-third monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. It contains the 35th and 36th chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|6}}. As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
==Blurb==
'''''EASY DOES IT'''''

''As a favor, Hazel must take care of a group of Hoppip for the day. Can she handle the stress of being around dozens of these crazy characters?''
